artifactKind: bounded acquisition and identity verification record (no statistic)

scope.what_this_records: acquiring one public NCBI GEO series and checking what the returned bytes say about its identity
scope.what_this_does_not_verify: the Welch t-test and Benjamini-Hochberg computation, and therefore the capability as a whole. No statistic was computed or is reported here.
scope.resource: public NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO); unrelated to the platform's pharma GEO module, whose tools were not used and are not involved
scope.bounded: one series, one platform, one acquisition pass per file; platforms are not pooled

series.title: NHGRI_Sarcoma_Baird
series.dates_source: !Series_submission_date / !Series_last_update_date / !Series_status inside the series matrix itself; not the fetch date
series.publication: Baird K, Davis S, Antonescu CR, et al. Gene expression profiling of human sarcomas: insights into sarcoma biology. Cancer Res. 2005;65(20):9226-35. doi:10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-05-1699. PMID 16230383 (the series states PMID 16230383; citation verified against the PubMed record)
series.contributor_as_stated: Kristin Baird, as the series record gives it (!Series_contributor); the series record lists the contact, not the full author list
series.contact_as_stated: Sean Davis, Genetics Branch, National Cancer Institute

platform.title: NHGRI 12k cDNA Custom Array
platform.dates_source: the ^PLATFORM record inside GPL1977's SOFT file

sources.role: series matrix (processed data, the file any computation would be taken from)
platform record, GPL1977 (its own annotation table, not the same columns as the GEO annotation file)
platform annotation as GEO computes it for this platform
sources.note: GEO annotation file; its columns (Gene symbol / Gene ID / Chromosome location) are GEO's own, and are not the platform table's columns (Symbol / LLID / CLONE_ID)

sources.role: series record and every sample record, as SOFT
sources.note: preserved; its size is dominated by 181 per-sample tables and it is not needed for the identity checks, which were taken from the matrix, the platform record and the annotation file

samples.evidence: !Sample_geo_accession has one column per sample; the matrix table header has the same 181 GSM names; every sample is listed under ^PLATFORM in GPL1977's own record

platform.evidence: !Series_platform_id and all 181 !Sample_platform_id values are GPL1977; GPL1977's record states !Platform_series_id = GSE2553; one platform, so nothing is pooled

genome_build.evidence: neither the series matrix nor the GPL1977 record states a genome build or assembly. GEO platform records of this generation do not carry one, and the platform's probe table is clone/EST based. No build is assumed, and none is inferred from anything else.
genome_build.consequence: coordinates or genomic positions must not be attributed to a build; the annotation file's Chromosome location strings are reproduced from GEO and are not a build declaration

value_scale.value: log ratio (two-channel, common reference); not stated in words anywhere in the file
value_scale.what_the_source_states: the matrix header carries no data-processing, scan or normalisation field (!Sample_data_processing, !Sample_scan_protocol, !Sample_hyb_protocol are absent), so the scale is never declared in words
value_scale.what_the_bytes_support: !Sample_channel_count is 2 for every sample; channel 1 is total RNA from the tumour and channel 2 is 'Pooled sarcoma cell lines'; !Series_overall_design says 'Common reference, multiclass gene profiling'; the values run from -13.2877 to 17.5125 with 42.7% of cells negative and a median of 0.1950 over 2,272,602 numeric cells. Raw intensities cannot be negative and are not centred on zero, so the values are a log ratio (log2) against the common reference.
value_scale.classification: supported_by_the_source_bytes, not stated by the source; stated as a derived classification in this record
value_scale.consequence: a value here is a tumour-versus-reference log ratio for one probe on one array, not an absolute expression level; the platform's own differential tool ingests values as log2 expression, and the reference channel is constant across samples, so a two-group comparison of these ratios is a comparison of ratios of ratios

probe_count.evidence: the matrix table has 12,600 data rows, all 181 !Sample_data_row_count values are 12,600, GPL1977's own table has 12,600 rows, and its annotation file has 12,600 rows

sources: GPL1977's own platform table columns: Symbol, Name, LLID (Entrez Gene id), CLONE_ID, UNIGENE
the GEO annotation file GPL1977.annot.gz: Gene symbol, Gene ID, Gene title, Chromosome location, GO terms
annotation.coverage: 10,573 of 12,600 annotation rows carry a gene symbol; 759 rows list more than one Entrez Gene id under Gene ID; 891 gene symbols appear on more than one probe row; the remaining 2,027 rows carry no gene symbol
annotation.limitation: the annotation file is GEO's, generated Jul 8 2008 by its HTTP header, and is older than any use of it here; the two annotation layers do not have the same columns and neither is a genome-build declaration

missing_values_in_matrix.evidence: counted by streaming the matrix table; no imputation was done and none is reported

unit.is: probe (an integer probe identifier in the matrix's ID_REF column; GPL1977.annot.gz maps each to a gene symbol and Entrez Gene id)
consequences: a probe mapped to several genes stays one row and is not copied to each gene
a gene with several probes has several rows
nothing is collapsed to a gene level in this record

group_declaration.candidate_annotation_field: !Sample_description, e.g. 'Diagnosis: Liposarcoma'; 25 distinct diagnosis values over the 181 samples
group_declaration.why_no_declaration_was_made: the two groups and the contrast are the researcher's decision; the skill declares groups before looking at any result, and no result was computed here

stop.stopped_at_step: after preserve-and-verify (skill step 1); steps 2-4 (declare groups, compute, render a report) were not started
stop.statement: no Welch t-test, no Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment, no effect size, no p-value and no top table were produced in this run; this record contains no statistic

method_status.preservation_and_identity_checks: done by hand from the platform's public download endpoints because the platform's own series tool was not callable in this session (see acquisition_attempts)
method_status.what_is_verified: that a series can be acquired and that what its bytes say about identity can be checked, with hashes and stated dates
method_status.what_is_not_verified: the differential-expression computation (Welch t-test per probe, Benjamini-Hochberg, the engine's limits and its receipt)
method_status.engineering_note: this run does not establish that the capability's own retrieval tool works end to end

acquisition_attempts.detail: no such tool was available to this session's toolset, so no retrieval from it was possible and none is claimed. Nothing about a capture from it is recorded here.

acquisition_attempts.attempt: platform web reader on the GEO record page, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE2553
acquisition_attempts.page_obtained: a reCAPTCHA browser check, not the record

acquisition_attempts.attempt: platform web reader on the GEO text view (form=text)
acquisition_attempts.detail: the reader does not read the geo/text content type; nothing was preserved from it
the gateway answered HTTP 401 to an unauthenticated request; no credential is available in this session, and nothing was retrieved through it

acquisition_attempts.attempt: public NCBI download endpoints (the same files GEO serves), used for the preserved bytes above
acquisition_attempts.detail: three files fetched over HTTPS and kept byte for byte; every hash in this record was recomputed from the bytes on disk in a separate step

checks.name: recompute-from-disk
checks.what_it_does: reads the bytes on disk again, recomputes each sha-256, re-detects the accessions inside the decompressed content, recounts the matrix rows and columns, and fails if any of it disagrees with this record
checks.result: 19 checks, all in agreement; the check refuses a record that contains an effect size or a p-value

checks.name: hash-recomputed-from-the-source
checks.what_it_does: re-hashed every preserved file in a separate process, without carrying over the acquisition step's own values

checks.name: live-hash-comparison
checks.what_it_does: re-fetched the same public URLs without keeping the bytes and compared the live sha-256 with the recorded one
checks.result: the series matrix and the annotation file still hash to the recorded values; the series matrix also still carries the same HTTP Last-Modified (Oct 4 2026)

references: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE2553 (series record; the matrix preserved here states the same accession and dates)
